description:
Fetch complete details for a single organization (company, government entity, holding company) by canonical Scrutica ID.
Returns: legal name, country of HQ, organization type, parent / subsidiary references, supply-chain edge counts.
US government listings that are not export controls: us_restrictive_listings holds the rows that name the organization, each with its list (dod_1260h: the Defense Department's Section 1260H list of "Chinese military companies"; ofac_ns_cmic: OFAC's Non-SDN Chinese Military-Industrial Complex Companies List; dhs_fascsa_exclusion: a Homeland Security FASCSA exclusion order), whether it is on the current list, the name as printed, its source (Federal Register notice or OFAC list file) and how it was matched (resolution 'name' or 'alias'; 'ambiguous' when the printed name matches several organizations, which are listed). on_1260h and on_ns_cmic are true when a current row resolves to the organization, false when no current row names it, and null when a current row names it among several organizations (unless the stored flag already reads true) or the rows cannot be read: names that match no record are not resolved, so false is not proof of absence. on_ofac_sdn is always null: OFAC's SDN list is not ingested.
Use scrutica_query_export_controls for BIS designation details. Use scrutica_get_supply_chain for full edge graphs.

company_id.description: REQUIRED. Canonical Scrutica organization ID. Format: 'org-<slug>' (e.g. 'org-nvidia', 'org-tsmc', 'org-huawei'). Resolve via scrutica_search first — do NOT guess slugs. Optional in the schema only so the aliases below can stand in; supply exactly one of these.

name: scrutica_get_company
